title: User-Facing API Services
summary: This module provides a unified interface for external users to interact with various AI functionalities, including diverse chat experiences, interactive D&D playground sessions, and retrieval of UI configuration metadata.

nodes.label: External User/Client
nodes.title: External API Consumer
nodes.description: Represents any external application or user interacting with the public API endpoints to access chat, D&D playground, or metadata services.

nodes.label: Chat Interface Endpoints
nodes.title: Chat API Services
nodes.description: Provides various API endpoints for chat interactions, including basic chat, persona-steered chat, and gated chat, with both synchronous and streaming options.

nodes.label: D&D Playground Endpoints
nodes.title: D&D Playground API
nodes.description: Exposes a streaming API for interactive Dungeons and Dragons playground sessions, allowing real-time event updates and complex interactions.

nodes.label: API Metadata Endpoints
nodes.title: UI Metadata Retrieval
nodes.description: Offers API endpoints to retrieve essential metadata, default prompts, and configuration details for the gated chat and D&D playground user interfaces.

nodes.label: Core Persona Logic
nodes.title: Persona & Gating Backend
nodes.description: Encapsulates the core logic for persona activations, dynamic gating mechanisms, and vector composition, driving the intelligent behavior of the chat and playground features.

nodes.label: Language Model Backend
nodes.title: Underlying LLM Service
nodes.description: The large language model service responsible for generating text responses, which is utilized by the various API endpoints for conversational and interactive features.

groups.label: User Interaction
groups.title: External User Interface
groups.description: Represents the external client or user interacting with the system's public API endpoints.

groups.label: API Surface
groups.title: Public API Endpoints
groups.description: The collection of user-facing API endpoints provided by this module for chat, D&D playground, and metadata services.

groups.label: Backend Services
groups.title: Core AI Backend
groups.description: The underlying AI logic and language model services that power the user-facing API functionalities.
